AvailableLearningTypes.title: AvailableLearningTypes

Enumeration of available learning types.

Button.title: Button
Button.description:
Represents a button in the chat UI.

This class is used to define a button that can be displayed in the chat
interface, including its label, callback, and optional chat message or state
store.

Args:
    label (str): The text displayed on the button.
    callback (ButtonCallback): The callback to be triggered when the button
        is pressed.
    chat_message (Optional[str]): The message to send when the button is pressed.
    store (Optional[dict]): State to store when the button is pressed.

Returns:
    None

ButtonCallback.title: ButtonCallback
ButtonCallback.description:
Represents a callback for a button.

This class defines the callback endpoint and data to be sent when a button
is pressed in the chat UI.

Args:
    endpoint (str): The endpoint to call.
    data (dict): The data to send to the endpoint.

Returns:
    None

ChatConfig.title: ChatConfig
ChatConfig.description:
Configuration from the backend for the chat in the frontend.

Args:
    max_messages_before_summarization (int): The maximum number of messages before
        summarization is triggered.

ConfigUpdateRequest.title: ConfigUpdateRequest
ConfigUpdateRequest.description: Request model for updating configuration values.

LLM.title: LLM
LLM.description:
Represents a language model (LLM) configuration.

This class is used to represent a language model in the code.

Args:
    id (str): The unique identifier for the LLM in LiteLLM.
    model_name (str): The base name of the LLM.
    label (str): The label of the LLM for endusers.
    api_base_url (str): The base URL for the LLM API.
    status (LLMStatus): The status of the LLM ('healthy' / 'unhealthy').

Returns:
    None

LearningTypeModel.title: LearningTypeModel
LearningTypeModel.description:
Represents a learning type model.

This class is used to define a learning type, including its ID, name, and
description.

Args:
    id (str): The unique identifier for the learning type.
    name (str): The name of the learning type.
    description (str): The description of the learning type.

Returns:
    None

LearningTypesResponseModel.title: LearningTypesResponseModel
LearningTypesResponseModel.description: Model for the available learning types.

LocaleType.title: LocaleType
LocaleType.description:
Represents supported locale types.

This enum is used to define the supported locales for the application, such as
English and German.

Args:
    EN: English locale.
    DE: German locale.

Returns:
    None

Message.title: Message
Message.description:
Represents a single chat message.

This model is used to encapsulate a message exchanged in the chat, including
the sender, content, and optional metadata.

Args:
    message (str): The content of the message.
    sender (str): The sender of the message (e.g., 'user', 'assistant').
    summary (Optional[str]): Optional summary of the message.

Returns:
    None

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description:
Represents a message response from the bot.

This class is used to encapsulate a message sent by the bot, including the
message content, sender, optional buttons, and meta information.

Args:
    message (str): The message content.
    sender (Optional[str]): The sender of the message.
    buttons (Optional[list[Button]]): List of buttons to display.
    meta_information (Optional[MetaInformation]): Additional metadata for
        the message.
    thoughts (Optional[str]): Optional thoughts or reasoning.

Returns:
    None

MetaInformation.title: MetaInformation
MetaInformation.description:
Contains meta information for a message.

This class holds metadata such as sources and the LLM model used for
generating the message.

Args:
    sources (Optional[dict[int, Source]]): The sources for the message identified by
        an integer id.
    llm_model (Optional[str]): The name of the LLM model used.

Returns:
    None

Module.title: Module
Module.description:
Represents a simple module of a topic.

This class is used to define a module, including its ID and title.
In contrast to the Skill class, this class does not have multiple levels.

Args:
    id (str): The unique identifier for the module.
    title (dict): The localized titles for the module.
    
Returns:
    None

ModulesResponse.title: ModulesResponse
ModulesResponse.description:
A Response model for retrieving multiple modules.

This model is used to return a list of modules.

Args:
    modules (list[Module]): A list of modules.
    
Returns:
    None

PersonalityTypeConversionResponse.title: PersonalityTypeConversionResponse
PersonalityTypeConversionResponse.description: Response model for personality type conversion.

PurposeModel.title: PurposeModel
PurposeModel.description:
The selection a user can take to change the model that is used.

Abstracts the difficult LLM names behind a user-friendly label. We decide for the 
user which LLM is used for which purpose.

llm_purpose.description: The purpose of the LLM to use (e.g., 'optimal' or 'reasoning')

RequestModel.title: RequestModel
RequestModel.description:
Request model for chat and bot endpoints.

This model contains all information sent from the frontend to the backend,
including chat history, user data, and session state.

Args:
    learning_type_id (AvailableLearningTypes): The ID of the learning type.
    chat_history (list[Message]): The list of previous messages in the conversation.
    language (str): The language code for localization.
    storage (dict): Key-value store for session-specific data.
    streaming (bool): Whether the response should be streamed.
    llm (Optional[LLM]): The requested language model.
    llm_purpose (Optional[str]): Purpose for which the LLM should be auto-selected.

Returns:
    None

Response.title: Response
Response.description:
Represents a response from the bot.

This class encapsulates a list of message responses to be sent to the frontend.

Args:
    messages (list[MessageResponse]): The list of message responses.
    storage (Optional[dict[str, str]]): Key-value store for session-specific data.
    instructions (Optional[list[str]]): Optional instructions for the frontend.

Returns:
    None

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description:
Represents a skill of a topic in the learning system.

This class is used to define a skill, including its ID, title, description,
and available levels.

Args:
    id (str): The unique identifier for the skill.
    title (dict): The localized titles for the skill.
    description (dict): The localized descriptions for the skill.
    levels (list): The list of levels for the skill.
    image (str): The URL of the image representing the skill.

Returns:
    None

SkillLevel.title: SkillLevel
SkillLevel.description:
Represents a skill level.

This class is used to define a skill level, including its ID, title,
description, and learning goals.

Args:
    id (str): The unique identifier for the skill level.
    title (dict): The localized titles for the skill level.
    description (dict): The localized descriptions for the skill level.
    learning_goals (dict): The localized learning goals for the skill level.

Returns:
    None

Source.title: Source
Source.description:
Represents a source document for a message.

This class is used to provide information about the source used for a message,
such as a document or reference.

Args:
    title (str): The title of the source.
    url (Optional[str]): The URL of the source.
    content (Optional[str]): The content of the source.

Returns:
    None

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: The format of a summary message.

SummaryResponse.title: SummaryResponse
SummaryResponse.description:
Represents a summary response for a chat session.

This class is used to return a summary of the chat and the number of
messages to keep after summarization.

Args:
    summary (str): The summary text.
    keep_last_messages_until (int): Number of messages to keep after summarization.

Returns:
    None

TitleResponse.title: TitleResponse
TitleResponse.description:
Represents a title response for a chat session.

This class is used to return a generated title for the chat session.

Args:
    title (str): The generated title.

Returns:
    None

TopicListModel.title: TopicListModel
TopicListModel.description: Model representing a collection of topics.

TopicModel.title: TopicModel
TopicModel.description: Model representing a topic in the application.
